claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_extra_turn
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants a second full combat turn at a specific initiative offset (Initiative - 10), scoped to the first round only. This is mechanically distinct from grant_extra_action (which adds one of the 12 standard actions within an existing turn). No existing v4 atom covers multi-turn allocation within a single round or initiative-offset-based turn scheduling.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal Initiative and your second turn at your Initiative minus 10.
